title: Average water use per person per day in urban area
markdown:
| SN | Purpose | Quantity (LPCD) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Drinking | 5 |
| 2 | Cooking | 5 |
| 3 | Bathing | 50 |
| 4 | Toilet flushing | 30 |
| 5 | Washing utensils | 15 |
| 6 | Washing the house | 10 |
| 7 | Washing of clothes | 20 |
|  | Total | 135 |
notes: Table is complete on physical page 96 (printed 11): seven numbered purpose rows and one total row.
Serial-column header is printed SN without periods, unlike S. N. in Table 1.2 on the preceding page.
Third-column header is set on two printed lines, Quantity / (LPCD), and is flattened with a single space.

Total row prints an empty serial cell, the word Total centred in the Purpose column, and 135. The printed rules keep the serial column separated, so the row is not a merged cell; cell_spans is empty and the empty serial cell is kept as an empty string.
The seven printed quantities add to 135 (5+5+50+30+15+10+20), matching the printed total. This is a reading check only; no printed value is changed.

Introductory sentence above the table on the same page gives 150 LPCD as the target benchmark for cities above 10 lakhs population (IS 1172:1993) and refers to this table; the number 150 is not part of the table and is not added to it.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of annotation-cleaned 144-dpi page renders and 3x table crops by delegated Pi child; no OCR.
transcription.observations: Read all table cells, repeated headers and cross-page source line; see batch REPORT.md and page-report.json.

visual_recheck.method: Distinct parent visual comparison against full-page images and source-region/zoomed PNGs; not independent human review.
visual_recheck.observations: Compared all 13 comparison rows, all nine benchmark rows and eight water-use rows, including headers and blank total serial cell. Confirmed unresolved 135* and separate 150 LPCD prose; no printed values changed.
